newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Airlines May load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Airlines May load factor up.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Monday its systemwide passenger load factor rose one percentage point in May to 74.8 percent from 73.8 percent.
Domestic load factor in May gained 2.4 points to 70.5 percent from 68.1 percent, while international load factor dropped 1.3 points to 80.8 percent from 82.1 percent.
Northwest Airlines said systemwide available seat miles rose 2.4 percent to 8.05 billion from 7.86 billion. Revenue passenger miles in the month gained 3.8 percent to 6.03 billion from 5.80 billion.
Cargo ton miles in May gained two percent to 182.7 million.
Year-to-date systemwide passenger load factor rose 1.3 percentage points to 72.4 percent from 71.1 percent.
Also for the year-to-date period, available seat miles rose 3.8 percent to 38.97 billion and revenue passenger miles gained 5.7 percent to 28.23 billion.
